comment: The PUFF sumRange is written as the voltage the knob-plus-jack total is worth, since the clamp itself is on the drive amount. The maker's own tooltips name the two character switches "Character (negative/linked)" and "Character (positive)", which is the clearest statement anywhere of what they do: the panel prints neither name. While the link switch is on, synchronizeCharacterSelectionFromUi copies one selector onto the other, so turning the positive one has no lasting effect; it comes up linked. The maker's own specification in doc/puffy.md lists six characters and calls BLOOM the default; the shipped build has seven, with TEETH added, and the specification is behind the code. The roaming fish, the roaming range bar and the waveform panel all sit in custom widgets; the range bar is a real ParamWidget and can be clicked, the fish and the waveform panel cannot. Roaming and the limiter mode are held outside the parameter system in the module's own JSON, so the limiter button reports its state only through its lamps.
